system.description: The Thuul recovers 1 additional HP after a night’s rest if the runic item remains against the skin during sleep. Keep this effect only while that condition and the linked Divinity Points are satisfied. It improves natural recovery; it does not heal immediately.
system.summary: Strengthens a sacred object and enhances the rune it bears.
